caption: The drawing shows a horizontal decorative border on a beige or off-white background. The border features a repeating pattern consisting of symmetrical geometric and stylized floral shapes. The main motif appears mushroom-like, composed of ochre and yellowish-brown colors with darker brown outlines and highlights. These motifs are connected by a green band at the bottom, which contains lighter green, vertical drop-like shapes regularly spaced between the primary motifs. The upper edge of the border has parallel lines in brown, yellow, and gold tones, contributing to a layered appearance. The border, occupying a small horizontal strip toward the center of the page, is contained within a rectangular block, while the rest of the page is left blank.
title: Wall Paper Border
